pullRequests.author: mxckiexz
pullRequests.reviewComment: I reviewed PR #25 against the F-04 contract and AC-33 to AC-38. The server implementation is correct for the required visibility rules. scope=mine is owner-scoped and newest-first; scope=review is restricted to APPROVER and returns only submitted requests from other users, oldest submission first; scope=all is restricted to ADMIN.

pullRequests.author: mxckiexz
pullRequests.reviewComment: I reviewed PR #26 against the F-05 contract and AC-39 to AC-44. The server-side implementation correctly restricts both admin routes to ADMIN users, excludes passwordHash from all responses, validates isActive and role, returns the specified 404/422 errors, prevents an administrator from changing their own account with SELF_CHANGE, and immediately invalidates an inactive user's existing session through requireAuth.

pullRequests.author: mxckiexz
pullRequests.reviewComment: I reviewed the UI implementation against AC-12, AC-23, AC-32, AC-38 and AC-44. The screens cover the required requester, approver and administrator flows: login/logout and role redirects, creating and editing drafts, server-calculated totals, incomplete-submit errors, request detail and ordered history, approval and rejection panels, administrator read-only lists, and user activation/role management.
